title: Best Way to Explore Barcelona
text: I’d highly recommend this experience! We loved being able to see Barcelona on our own with the guidance of the car. The guidance from the car was clear, the guys who got us set up were professional, and did a great job helping us prior to getting or US licenses translated. Great experience!
author: Aracia_H

title: Wow!
text:
What a great experience at GoCar Barcelona! 🚗☀️
We really had a great day and were able to discover the whole of Barcelona in a super fun way. The route was clear, the cars are easy to drive and the feeling of freedom as you drive through the city is really fantastic.

Along the way, you'll pass all the highlights and see how beautiful Barcelona really is — from its impressive architecture to its cosy streets and sea views. Truly a unique way to explore the city!

Definitely recommended for anyone visiting Barcelona who wants something different from the standard tour. This was without a doubt
author: 279jacke

title: Birthday trip :-)
text:
A totally great experience. Full Gaudi in the truest sense of the word.
We had the e-mobile and it even took us as far as Tibidabo.
The good thing is, you can do the given routes (definitely useful for Barcelona - newcomers), but you can also drive your own route. 
We had full attention on the streets on our side.
A wonderful birthday.
We'll be back next time.
author: matzolli

title: Complete tour
text:
Total 30 km in the city, a brand new (electric) car that looks like a 1970 Buggy. 
GPS guides you, just follow the path, it takes a little time to get used to. Every time you approach a monument or an interesting site, you hear a commentary (in French) and often with a lot of humor, fun and fun. 
To do as a couple, because car 2 places, you need the driving license
author: Curieuses-BE

title: Excellent tour throughout Barcelona
text:
Me and my fiancé were very excited about the full day tour. Upon entering we were excellently helped. In addition, the GoCar met our wishes and drove perfectly. The GoCar told us exactly in time about the street or the building. The built-in navigation was also excellent, the GoCar indicated the direction on time. 
All in all we did an excellent tour with our buddy the GoCar. We recommend the GoCar for everyone from young to old!
author: Wilco M

title: Fun way to see the city
text: A fun way to tour the town. Even though it was explained to us to look for blue/green lines when parking (not yellow/white) we weren’t told about needing to enter the GoCars license plate into the box-so the $50 euro ticket added on was not a fun surprise. Also suggest if we push the button to go back to the store that it would still keep us on your gps tour, but the fastest way so we can still enjoy the history as we head back.
